Listen to what is happening to our families and our children in the public schools today. Two Michigan middle-school brothers were targeted and dragged into a fight simply for wearing hoodies emblazoned with the phrase “Let’s Go Brandon”. 

Let's remember where this phrase comes from—it was popularized during a 2021 NASCAR event when a crowd was shouting “F*** Joe Biden!” but the NBC interviewer told racer Brandon Brown they were yelling “Let’s go Brandon!”. 

Instead of teaching discipline, personal responsibility, and respect, these progressive school boards and activist lower courts are playing political games. These lower courts have brazenly ruled that schools can ban wearing such apparel as ‘can reasonably be interpreted as profane’. It is an absolute disgrace that basic expression and our national heritage are being censored under the guise of maintaining order, while these institutions surrender any true standard of modesty and respect. 

Thankfully, the case is now headed to the U.S. Supreme Court, with the siblings represented by the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression. It is time for real authority to be restored, to put an end to this ongoing war on our kids, our values, and our free speech.
